summary: Checked both estimates against the published nine-page PDF, the complete markdown conversion (all 323 lines, including references), extraction rules 4-6, and the codebook. No appendix or embedded supplement is present. No extraction errors or missing eligible outcomes or contrasts were found. The three script flags are false positives caused by image-only tables. PyMuPDF page text and find_tables() omit Tables 1 and 2; their embedded images were extracted and inspected directly in memory. On PDF p. 6 (printed p. 100), Table 2 prints the complete Human-AI row as "Human-AI 150 2.94 0.37 3.21 0.22 2.99 [2.95, 3.04]" and the Human-Search row as "Human-Search 150 2.85 0.38 2.98 0.31 3.19 [3.15, 3.24]". The unadjusted post-test means and SDs are therefore correctly assigned. On PDF p. 5 (printed p. 99), Table 1 has .39*** at row 11, Condition, and column 2, Post-test creativity. Section 3.4 explicitly codes Human-Search as 0 and Human-AI as 1. Section 3.1 on PDF p. 4 (printed p. 98) confirms 300 analyzed participants, 150 per condition; these are analyzed people, not recruited counts or numbers of responses. Table 2 confirms the arm counts. The Section 4 ANCOVA prose on PDF p. 5 prints Human-AI M = 3.19, SE = 0.02, 95% CI [3.15, 3.24]; Human-Search M = 2.99, SE = 0.02, 95% CI [2.95, 3.04]; adjusted difference 0.20; F(1, 293) = 58.28; p < .001; and Cohen's d = 0.77, matching the extraction. The recorded CI is correctly identified as the treatment-mean interval. Table 2 reverses the adjusted means and CIs relative to this prose. That is an unresolved inconsistency in the paper, already explicitly preserved in the extraction, not a transcription error; this verification does not resolve it. Methods and the participant-level analyses support with_ai, overall_creativity, automated_score, participant unit and se_basis, more_creative, outcome_with_ai=true, immediate timing, within_person=null, and ai_vs_active for both records. The fixed unassisted fork baseline does not make the randomized post-test comparison a crossover or an after_ai outcome. Only one output-scored creativity outcome and one AI-versus-search contrast are reported, represented by unadjusted and ANCOVA analyses of the same sample. Self-reported ideation and CSE, mediation and moderation effects, and nonrandomized baseline changes are correctly excluded. Figures 1 and 2 supply no additional eligible numerical contrast; no plotted values were estimated.
